items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: And you'd either have to let Dr. Shushaw and pay about $220.

ctx.x: I suppose my kid then is going to get a banjo, takes your advice, and says, well, the public wants that. Would you advise him to get a regular four-string tenor banjo, or would you advise him to get a guitar banjo?

Well, I'd advise to get a tenor because a tenor is easier to find. You can buy a tenor most of the time, but the guitar is kind of a scarce instrument. They're not stocking them anymore. And you'd either have to let Dr. Shushaw and pay about $220. The banjo alone would cost him $180 to have it made in the guitar. And I guess with the case, the case must run him around about $60. The outfit might run around about $225, $230. And you'd have to have it made, especially a lot, that they don't stock them. So I'd…
Oh, and what about the five-string? Is that what's called pector banjo?
